name: Xiao Long
appearance: White gi, black belt, black hair
altAppearance: Retro white tracksuit with yellow stripes
backstory: Orphaned at a young age, Xiao Long was taken in by Master Chow after demonstrating an unusual ability to "see patterns" in both combat and numbers. Raised within the discipline of Sudoku Fighting, he trained relentlessly to master both mind and body. Though outwardly calm, he carries a deep internal drive to prove his worth—not just as a fighter, but as someone who overcame nothingness.
altIdentity: A freer, more expressive version of Xiao Long. Represents instinct over discipline.

name: Chuck
appearance: Blue gi, blonde hair, blue eyes
altAppearance: Grey uniform, muted palette, calmer demeanor
backstory: Chuck trained seriously in Sudoku Fighting but never lost his love for fun. He treats every battle like a beach day. Relaxed, unpredictable, and surprisingly sharp. His humor masks a deeply competitive edge and a strong sense of loyalty to fellow fighters.
altIdentity: A quieter, more introspective version. Less jokes, more precision.

name: Jonathan
appearance: Orange gi, brown hair with green streak
backstory: Raised in the high-tech skyline of Sky City, Jonathan blends modern ambition with traditional discipline. He sees Sudoku Fighting as both art and performance. His confidence borders on arrogance, but he backs it up with raw skill.
altIdentity: The "ideal champion" persona—focused, slightly more serious, self-aware.

name: Senna
appearance: Beanie, pigtails, army jacket, baggy pants
backstory: Senna grew up surviving on instinct in the rough streets of Shinobi Alley. Unknown to many, she was secretly trained in ninja arts. She blends street fighting, breakdance movement, and stealth techniques into a chaotic but effective style.
altIdentity: Her true disciplined self—focused, silent, deadly.

name: Boombox
backstory: Created through underground military experiments, Boombox was trained as a living weapon. She broke free from control and now fights on her own terms. Despite her engineered origin, she has a strong sense of independence—and a surprisingly playful side.
altIdentity: A colder, more calculated version—less emotion, more efficiency.

name: Master Chow
backstory: A lifelong master of Sudoku Fighting, he believes true strength lies in balance between logic and instinct. He trains fighters not just to win—but to become forces of good in a chaotic world.
